newsitem.title: UK: Shell pulls out of Romanian oil exploration.
newsitem.headline: Shell pulls out of Romanian oil exploration.

text.p: Royal Dutch/Shell has pulled out of oil exploration in Romania after failing to find crude in a series of exploration plays in Transylvania, a company spokesman said.
Three exploration wells drilled over a five-year period in Romania's block 10 had all proved dry, the spokesman said.
Shell, operator in the block, was in partnership with private Saudi Arabian oil financier Nimir Petroleum Company Ltd.
The company was in negotiations on another exploration block but had no early plans for fresh operations in the country, the spokesman said.
Shell would maintain its representative office in Bucharest and its 15 retail sites in the country, he said.
